evidence: Hovering (after Radix tooltip delay) over the dashed SVG connector between Submit final report / Review project proposal / Complete tax filing opened a tooltip: 'Dependency Chain Submit final report pending Review project proposal pending Complete tax filing pending', showing the chain and each task's completion state.

Hovering over the blocked-warning icon on 'Complete tax filing' (blocked by 'Review project proposal') showed tooltip 'Dependency Chain / Review project proposal / pending', identifying the pending prerequisite.
Sort=Priority order: Review project proposal(High), Complete tax filing(High), Submit final report(High), Schedule dentist appointment(Medium), Buy groceries(Low) - High before Medium before Low.
Created 'Plan team offsite' task; active count increased from 5 to 6 and the task appeared in the active list.

Created task with title 'Plan team offsite', description 'Organize logistics for the Q3 team offsite event.', deadline 2026-09-15, priority Low, prerequisite 'Buy groceries'; saved task showed all these exact values (Sep 15, Low, prerequisite warning naming Buy groceries).
Assigned 'Buy groceries' as prerequisite to new task during creation; saved task displays blocked state with 'Prerequisite \"Buy groceries\" incomplete'.
Switching to 'Completed 2' view shows only completed tasks (Reply to client emails, Organize desk) with correct count; switching back to Active shows only active/blocked tasks with correct count.
Blocked tasks show muted/grayed title (text-muted-foreground class vs none for active) and their complete toggle is disabled (complete.enabled=false) until prerequisites complete.
Single prerequisite: 'Prerequisite \"Review project proposal\" incomplete'; multiple: 'Submit final report' shows '2 prerequisites incomplete'.

issue: Blocked task's Edit button is fully disabled, not partially restricted
actual: For blocked task 'Complete tax filing' (prerequisite incomplete), the Edit action button is disabled entirely (Playwright reports 'element is not enabled'), so there is no way to open any edit form to change description or priority. The spec requires description and priority to remain editable while title/deadline are locked, but the app blocks all editing for blocked tasks.

evidence: Edited 'Schedule dentist appointment' -> changed title to 'Schedule dentist appointment (updated)', description, deadline to Sep 5, priority to High, added prerequisite 'Buy groceries'; all changes persisted and reflected (now shown blocked by Buy groceries). Deleted 'Plan team offsite' task: active count dropped 6->5 and task removed from the list.

Completed 'Review project proposal' (no prerequisites, eligible): it left the active list, active count went 5->4, completed count went 2->3, and it now appears in Completed view. Dependent tasks correctly updated (Complete tax filing became unblocked/active).

Blocked task 'Schedule dentist appointment' complete toggle is disabled (cursor-not-allowed, click blocked by Playwright as 'not enabled'). 'Complete tax filing' was disabled while its prerequisite was incomplete, then became enabled and was successfully completed once the prerequisite (Review project proposal) was completed.
Whitespace-only title ('   ' and '    ') kept the Create Task submit button disabled; canceled the form and task counts remained unchanged (3 active, 4 completed), confirming no task was created.

Editing 'Review project proposal' (task 1), the prerequisite selection list excluded itself and both 'Complete tax filing' (direct dependent) and 'Submit final report' (indirect dependent via chain 7->4->1), showing only 'Schedule dentist appointment', 'Buy groceries', 'Organize desk', 'Reply to client emails' as available options - preventing a cycle.

Completed tasks (e.g. 'Reply to client emails') remained visible and available in the Completed view (not deleted) after being marked complete. Clicking its complete toggle again reopened it: it moved back to the Active view (active count 3->4, completed 4->3) and out of Completed.

issue: Reopening a prerequisite leaves completed dependents in an invalid completed+blocked state
actual: Completed 'Submit final report' (depends on 'Review project proposal' and 'Complete tax filing', both completed at the time). Reopened prerequisite 'Review project proposal' via its complete toggle - the app allowed this without warning. Afterward, 'Complete tax filing' and 'Submit final report' still appear only in the Completed view (completed count 3, they are absent from Active view) yet each now shows blocked-warning 'Prerequisite \"Review project proposal\" incomplete' and complete.enabled=false. This means both tasks are simultaneously completed and blocked, violating the constraint. The system neither prevented the reopen nor returned the dependents to an incomplete state.

evidence: Sort=Deadline order: Buy groceries(Tomorrow=Aug26), Reply to client emails(Tomorrow), Review project proposal(Aug27), Schedule dentist appointment(Sep5), then 'Read a book' (no deadline) placed last after all dated tasks.

'Read a book' (no description/deadline supplied) renders only title+priority text 'Read a bookMedium' with no paragraph/deadline element. Tasks with description/deadline (e.g. 'Review project proposal') display both. Blocked tasks show a prerequisite warning label. Completed tasks render title with 'line-through text-muted-foreground' styling distinguishing them from active tasks (no such class on active task titles).
